goals.why_it_matters: The ledger's own arithmetic is good — the missing thing was records. The last balance anyone wrote down is $1.858 on 2026-08-31; $0.59 has been spent since with no balance recorded, two runs carry no price at all, and the original credit purchase — the actual cash — is recorded nowhere. One reading of the vendor's real balance closes the tail.
